newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Bank Umum Servitia to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Bank Umum Servitia to float shares.

text.p: Indonesia's private PT Bank Umum Servitia said on Thursday it will sell 20 percent of its paid-up capital to the public next week to raise 32 billion rupees.
The bank said it will offer 40 million shares, with a nominal value of 500 rupiah each, at 800 rupiah a share.
The medium-sized bank said the offering period will be from November 26-28 and the shares will be listed on December 11 on the Jakarta and Surabaya Stock Exchanges.
It said 65 percent of the proceeds would be used to expand its lending activity, with the balance to increase its number of branches and upgrade its computer system.
The bank forecast a net profit of 18 billion rupiah in 1996 against 9.4 billion rupiah last year.
The lead underwriter of the issue is PT Makindo.
